diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ebf9a58
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
@@ -0,0 +1,26 @@
+from click.utils import make_default_short_help
+
+
+def prepare(record):
+    """Validate a record and return its normalized summary fields."""
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not (key := key.strip()):
+        raise ValueError("key must be a nonempty string")
+
+    value = record.get("value")
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("value must be a string")
+
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("enabled must be a bool")
+
+    return {
+        "key": key,
+        "value": value,
+        "display": make_default_short_help(value, max_length=20),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }

diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
index ebf9a58..e1dd991 100644
--- a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
@@ -24,3 +24,20 @@ def prepare(record):
         "display": make_default_short_help(value, max_length=20),
         "enabled": enabled,
     }
+
+
+def batch(records):
+    """Prepare a list of records with unique normalized keys."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+
+    prepared = []
+    seen = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        key = item["key"]
+        if key in seen:
+            raise ValueError(f"duplicate key: {key!r}")
+        seen.add(key)
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

diff --git a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
index e1dd991..b7af923 100644
--- a/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
+++ b/src/reusebench_click_summary/steps.py
@@ -41,3 +41,12 @@ def batch(records):
         seen.add(key)
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records):
+    """Group enabled displays by the first character of their normalized key."""
+    groups = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return groups

@@ -50,3 +50,11 @@ def group(records):
         if item["enabled"]:
             groups.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
     return groups
+
+
+def merge(left, right):
+    """Overlay prepared right records on left records without reordering keys."""
+    merged = {item["key"]: item for item in batch(left)}
+    for item in batch(right):
+        merged[item["key"]] = item
+    return list(merged.values())
